summary: Local Windows HTML application for reviewing Azure DevOps inherited-process changes and explicitly approving supported synchronization to selected child processes. Reuse the PowerShell REST gateway, but implement and test the missing reconciliation and approval engine; no live ADO calls, synchronization, deployment, or cloud provisioning is authorized by planning.

workspaceSignals.decisionReason: Add a local UI and backend to the existing PowerShell process REST gateway and offline test suite; the gateway is not a reconciliation engine.

questions.question: Confirm the local review and synchronization workflow.

questions.question: Confirm backend safeguards, persistence, tests and documentation.
questions.answer: Real ADO REST integration via the existing gateway; complete fixed-window audit pagination and source-GUID evidence binding; stable canonical snapshots; explicit local-ID mappings; three-way reconciliation preserving target-only customization; narrow supported operation adapters; immutable hash-bound approval; per-operation live preconditions and semantic verification; restricted local journals/checkpoints; offline regression and browser security tests; local setup and limitation documentation.
questions.rationale: Only inherited source and targets with the same system parent are eligible; child means an explicitly selected target, not a nested inherited process. Audit is evidence, not replayable history. First run adopts a baseline without writes; existing drift needs a separately approved bootstrap. Block destructive, shared/global, unsupported, ambiguous and unevidenced writes; block unknown project impact, retention gaps, incomplete pagination and unstable snapshots. Stop on failure or drift; reconcile ambiguous writes before retry; no automatic rollback. Advance checkpoints only after all selected targets verify and an idempotent preview is empty. Fixed HTTPS Microsoft hosts, no redirects; do not broaden permissions. Bind loopback only, validate Host/Origin, deny cross-origin access, use a per-launch session and anti-CSRF checks, render untrusted metadata as text, redact secrets and sensitive errors. Reuse gateway, credential enrollment and existing PowerShell tests, adding focused engine/adapter/browser tests and disposable-target acceptance instructions; no live tests are authorized now.
questions.recommendedChoice: Real ADO REST integration via the existing gateway; complete fixed-window audit pagination and source-GUID evidence binding; stable canonical snapshots; explicit local-ID mappings; three-way reconciliation preserving target-only customization; narrow supported operation adapters; immutable hash-bound approval; per-operation live preconditions and semantic verification; restricted local journals/checkpoints; offline regression and browser security tests; local setup and limitation documentation.

questions.question: Where should users enter the separate reader and writer PATs? Do not enter a PAT in this form.
questions.rationale: The requested app begins by asking for a PAT. App entry needs a new reviewed enrollment adapter; terminal entry can reuse the existing script. Neither option allows secrets in chat, planning forms, tool prompts, command arguments, environment variables, browser storage, reports or logs. Use separate short-lived reader/writer PATs with least privilege; load writer only for approved apply.

options.label: Hidden local terminal prompt
options.description: App starts with organization and credential status/setup; user enrolls PATs using the existing hidden PowerShell prompt and Windows DPAPI.

options.label: Local app password fields
options.description: App collects reader/writer PATs in cleared password fields; hardened same-origin backend enrollment encrypts with DPAPI, never logging or persisting plaintext.

questions.question: Confirm local-only storage for baselines, redacted evidence, plans and journals.
questions.rationale: Durable local baselines and verification journals are required. No uploads, hosted media, Azure Functions, Azure resources or deployment are selected. Keep internal process metadata outside the repository; persist only minimal evidence, not raw audit responses or actor/network identities.

options.label: Protected local files
options.description: Access-restricted files under LOCALAPPDATA/AdoProcessSync; DPAPI credentials separate from run folders. No cloud storage or database.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: No persisted baselines or checkpoints; incompatible with the proposed safe reconciliation workflow.

questions.question: Does this local single-user app need a separate user sign-in?
questions.rationale: Local-only operation with per-launch API authorization and explicit write approval, not a multi-user hosted service. This does not disable loopback API security or choose ADO credentials.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Add a separate user sign-in flow beyond the local session.

options.label: No
options.description: Single Windows user; protected per-launch local session, no account system. ADO PAT setup remains separate.
